Voter ID Card — Apply, Download & Correction Guide

• Last updated: 2026-09-15 · 3 min read
Share:
In simple words:

Voter ID Card (EPIC — Electors Photo Identity Card) Election Commission of India dwara issue kiya jaata hai. Yeh proof of identity aur voting rights dono ka kaam karta hai. 18 saal ya usse zyada age ka koi bhi Indian citizen apply kar sakta hai.

Simple explanation

Voter ID Card ek photo identity card hai jo Election Commission of India (ECI) issue karta hai. Iska main purpose hai elections mein vote daalne ke liye identity verify karna. Lekin aaj kal yeh ek widely accepted proof of identity bhi hai — bank account, SIM card, aur kai jagah kaam aa jaata hai.

Apply karne ke liye aapko Indian citizen hona zaroori hai aur age 18 years ya usse zyada honi chahiye. Aap online NVSP portal (nvsp.in) ya Voter Helpline app se Form 6 bhar ke apply kar sakte hain. Application mein Aadhaar, passport-size photo, aur address proof lagta hai.

Agar aapka Voter ID card kho jaaye ya usme koi galti hai (naam, address, photo), toh aap correction form bhar sakte hain — online NVSP portal par ya offline apne nearest Electoral Registration Office (ERO) mein. Form 8 correction aur update dono ke liye use hota hai.

Aaj kal aap apna Voter ID card digitally bhi download kar sakte hain — e-EPIC format mein. NVSP portal ya Voter Helpline app par registered mobile number se OTP verify karke aap downloadable PDF le sakte hain jo original card jitna hi valid hai.

Why does it matter?

Voter ID card sirf vote daalne ke liye hi nahi — yeh India mein sabse widely accepted government photo ID hai. Bank account, gas connection, SIM card, property documents — kai jagah yeh primary identity proof ke roop mein kaam aata hai. Bina Voter ID ke aap apna democratic right bhi exercise nahi kar sakte.

Example

In numbers

Maan lijiye aapka naam beta 18 saal ka hua hai. Aap NVSP portal par jaake Form 6 bharte hain, apna Aadhaar, photo aur address proof upload karte hain. 2-4 weeks mein verification complete hota hai aur aapka naam electoral roll mein add ho jaata hai. Phir aap e-EPIC download kar sakte hain ya physical card post se aa jaata hai.

Important things to know

  • Voter ID card Election Commission of India issue karta hai — kisi state government ka kaam nahi hai.
  • Eligibility: Indian citizen, 18+ years age, aur jis constituency mein rehte hain wahan register hona hai.
  • Online apply: NVSP portal (nvsp.in) par Form 6 bharein — free hai, koi charge nahi lagta.
  • Required documents: Aadhaar card, passport-size photograph, address proof (utility bill, ration card, etc.).
  • e-EPIC (digital Voter ID) download kar sakte hain — original card jitna hi valid hai.
  • Correction/update ke liye Form 8 use hota hai — naam, address, photo change karwa sakte hain.
  • Status check NVSP portal par registration number se ho sakta hai.
  • Ek person ka ek hi Voter ID ho sakta hai — multiple registrations illegal hain.

Common mistakes

  • Galat constituency mein apply karna — aapko wahan apply karna hai jahan aap currently rehte hain, na ki jahan pehle rehte the.
  • Blurry photo upload karna — photo clear nahi hogi toh application reject ho sakti hai.
  • Aadhaar aur Voter ID ka naam match na karna — spelling difference se verification mein problem aati hai.
  • Correction form mein galat details bharna — Form 8 mein jo bhi change karwana hai uska proof zaroori hai.
  • Duplicate registration — agar aapne pehle se kahin Voter ID banwaya hai toh doosri jagah nahi bana sakte.

Frequently asked questions

Voter ID card ke liye online apply kaise karein?

NVSP portal (nvsp.in) par jaayein, 'Apply online for registration of new voter' section mein Form 6 select karein. Apni details bharein, Aadhaar, photo aur address proof upload karein, aur submit karein. Reference number milega jisse status track kar sakte hain.

Voter ID card download kaise karein (e-EPIC)?

NVSP portal ya Voter Helpline app par jaayein. Apna EPIC number ya Form reference number enter karein, registered mobile par OTP aayega, verify karein aur e-EPIC PDF download ho jaayega. Yeh printable aur original card jitna hi valid hai.

Voter ID mein naam ya address kaise change karein?

NVSP portal par Form 8 bharein — isme correction aur update dono ho sakte hain. Naam change ke liye supporting document (Aadhaar, gazette notification etc.) lagta hai. Address change ke liye naye address ka proof upload karein. Process 2-4 weeks mein complete hota hai.

Voter ID card ka status kaise check karein?

NVSP portal par 'Know your application status' section mein apna reference number enter karein. Ya Voter Helpline app / helpline number 1950 par call karke bhi status pata kar sakte hain.

Voter ID card kho gaya hai toh duplicate kaise banwayein?

NVSP portal par Form 8 mein 'Duplicate EPIC' option select karein. FIR copy zaroori nahi hai lekin kuch states mein maang sakte hain. Fee lag sakti hai ₹25-₹100 (state-wise alag). Naya card 2-4 weeks mein mil jaata hai.

Kya NRI Voter ID banwa sakte hain?

Haan, NRI bhi Voter ID ke liye eligible hain agar unka naam Indian passport mein hai. Lekin physically polling station par jaake vote karna zaroori hai — postal ballot sirf specific categories (defence, government employees posted abroad) ke liye available hai.
